question: How much road, address and place data does the quest app's Mississippi map bundle contain, and how current is it?
statement: quest's Mississippi bundle: 545,431 road segments, 666,950 address ranges/points, 126,894 places; OSM 2026-10-22, Overture 2026-10-21.0.
argument:
The quest Fangorn app publishes one region record, quest:region:us-ms: 545,431 road segments, 666,950 address ranges and points, and 126,894 businesses and places, built from OpenStreetMap (2026-10-22), US Census TIGER/Line 2026 and Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0. Routing runs on-device; typed addresses never leave the browser.

Caveats: Counts are the publisher's own record text; the 23.9 MB bundle itself was not decoded.
